messages:
alex: FYI — got paged for increased tail latency on inference-prod in eu-west. I'm scheduled as primary for the midnight stretch but need to step away for a personal emergency around 02:00–05:30 UTC. Can someone cover the primary duties for that window? :wave:

maya: I can take 02:00–04:00 UTC. I have a calendar conflict 04:00–05:00 though. will follow runbook before taking over.

sam: I can cover 02:00–06:00 UTC if needed. heads up I'm in APAC so my awake hours are weird but i can take the full window.

alex: Thanks both. Critical part is ensuring the pages route to a live human and the fallback policy is set. current secondary is tariq — @tariq are you able to be the backup if maya covers 02–04 and sam takes 04–06?

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4532 opened: inference-prod latency alarm triggered (p95 > 1200ms). Primary: alex, Secondary: tariq. Severity: Sev2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4532

tariq: I can be secondary for the window. If alex hands off, I can take escalations up to 04:30 UTC. after that i'm reachable but sleeping; sam should be primary by then.

jen: Quick checklist reminder — when you hand off please: 1) update pagerduty assignment, 2) post a short context msg in #eng-oncall, 3) attach the latest traces link and recent dashboard view.

alex: Copy. I'll update PD and post handoff note. Also leaving these runbook pointers for whoever picks this up:

- Runbook: "Latency spikes — Inference" https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-inference
- Quick mitigation commands:
```
# restart worker pool on eu-west nodes
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-worker-eu-west
# tail recent logs for 1h
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-proxy -c proxy --since=1h | grep "p95" -A5
```

maya: On it — i'll run the quick checks and check KV cache hit rate. if caching looks fine i'll try a controlled rollout revert to last stable model variant.

sam: If we need immediate throughput relief and model fallback doesn't help, consider throttling long requests via the router policy, and enable prefix caching for the next 2hrs. I'll be prepared to push that.

alex: Handing off now — updated PD to assign primary to maya for 02:00–04:00 UTC, primary to sam for 04:00–06:00 UTC, tariq as secondary for 02:00–04:30. Posted in #eng-oncall and pinned dashboards.

maya: Confirming takeover. Running the runbook steps now. Leaving progress notes in-thread.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty assignment changed: primary -> maya (02:00–04:00 UTC), primary -> sam (04:00–06:00 UTC), secondary -> tariq (02:00–04:30 UTC).

alex: Thank you team. If anything escalates past rollback/fallback, please escalate to platform-leads and open a bridge.

sam: noted — i'll be on the bridge if it goes to Sev1. ping me directly if you can't reach PD. :phone:

jen: Also if customer-impact is >10% of requests, update the incidents page and notify CS with the template in the runbook.

maya: status update 02:18 UTC — KV cache hit rate dropped 30%. restarted worker pool, p95 dropped from 1250ms -> 700ms. continuing monitoring.

tariq: Good recovery so far. I'll stay on watch until 04:30.

alex: Closing handoff thread — thanks all for covering. I'll follow up with a short post-incident note tomorrow if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
